part.text:
I found the red ball and walked up to it. The robot is now crouched in rest mode, facing the ball. The last image shows the ball a short distance in front of its feet, a little left of center.

The ball wasn't visible from where the robot started, so I walked forward and then turned left. After that it showed up beyond a black case. I sidestepped the case and walked straight at the ball.

My last move before resting was a small turn left. The rest call came right after it, so the robot is facing the ball but not dead center on it.
